content.text:
The file looks good. Now let's build the olean with the command from the S1933 report and verify EXIT=0, no warnings/errors, and get the SHA. Use:
```
lake env lean -j1 -R D:\lean -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1942PrePsiFiveActual.olean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1942PrePsiFiveActual.lean
```
This may take ~10 minutes due to the `ring` proof. We'll run it in the background and monitor. Also, we should ensure the output directory exists.

Let's start the build.

content.name: run_code
content.arguments: {"code": "const r = await tools.pwsh({ description: \"Build S1942 olean\", command: \"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .lake\\\\build\\\\lib\\\\lean\\\\tmp\\\\sheaf\\\\xif\\\\paper | Out-Null; lake env lean -j1 -R D:\\\\lean -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1942PrePsiFiveActual.olean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1942PrePsiFiveActual.lean 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath tmp\\\\sheaf\\\\xif\\\\paper\\\\_S1942_build.log; exit $LASTEXITCODE\", timeoutMs: 900000, run_in_background: true });\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify(r));\n", "description": "Start S1942 olean build in background"}
